about: Control center (CONTROL_CENTER_SPEC.md): simulator numbers that are not in SITE.json. Every number has basis + src. basis: sourced | analog | derived | designed | STD | research | EST | judgment (analog = a document on a similar product, as in the inbox cards). EST = engineering estimate waiting for research (the `wait` field names the research item of CONTROL_CENTER_SPEC.md section 7); the panel shows EST numbers as estimates. SITE.json stays the source of the graph, the capacities it has (t_h), volumes, interlock thresholds; world/sim/geometry.json has the derived lengths. Research R1-R7: research/sim_params.md (2026-09-29, cards unverified, key quotes checked in the saved files by the main session).

residual.src: flat floor, gravity only: the grain surface left slopes at the repose angle (drained_angle_deg) down to the open outlets. Centre outlet only: a cylinder of height R tan(phi) minus the cone = 2/3 pi R^3 tan(phi); centre + side outlets along the tunnel line (taken as the whole chord, a lower bound): tan(phi) * integral |y| dA = 4/3 R^3 tan(phi). To compare with the source of R4. Researcher's geometry for the real 6 side outlets: ≈ 887 t at 34° (rec_94b89ff8), this lower bound ≈ 895 t

sweep_t_h.src: sweep auger (S1.sweep 18.5 kW + tractor 1.1 kW, p.8) moving the residual to the centre outlet — not found in R4 (research/sim_params.md)

sweep_rule.src: the sweep auger is switched on only after the gravity discharge has stopped (mass at the residual)

drained_angle_deg.src: EN 1991-4:2006 table E.1 wheat phi_r 34° (rec_9d4ad397, PDF p.101); ЛНТУ textbook table 1.6: wheat 24-26° when poured, 34-36° when it collapses (rec_a104798c) — the grain left after discharge has slid, so the collapse angle; the filling cone keeps 27° (geometry.json)

pass_through.src: no storage of their own in the model: a gravity point, a pipe, the tower pit under Ш1 (H3 / H4 boots take from it), the scale decks, the separator (limited by its t/h)
